name: graylog-abuseipdb
description: Browser extension that enriches a Graylog IP field with AbuseIPDB reputation and geolocation.
author: eldriic

scripts.lint: npm run check && npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --channel unlisted --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts
scripts.submit:firefox: npm run lint && web-ext sign --channel listed --amo-metadata store/firefox/amo-metadata.json --approval-timeout 0 --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts
